purpose: Read-only validation of scoped partially-verified permission ledger, archived test receipts, current source inventory and unchanged shared assertions
command:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
guide=Path('docs/permissions.md').read_text()
assert sum(line.startswith('```') for line in guide.splitlines()) % 2 == 0, 'Unbalanced Markdown fences'
blocks=re.findall(r'```xml\n(.*?)\n```',guide,re.S)
for block in blocks:
 ET.fromstring('<root xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools">'+block+'</root>')
 assert 'MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE' not in block
assert any('NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription' in b and 'NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescription' in b for b in blocks)
assert any('NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription' in b and 'NSBonjourServices' in b and '_lnp._tcp.' in b for b in blocks)
records=json.loads(Path('docs/development/resolutions/PERM-permissions.json').read_text())
assert [r['id'] for r in records]==[f'PERM-{n:03}' for n in list(range(1,18))+[24]]
for row in records:
 assert set(row)=={'id','status','changes','affected_paths','tests','remaining','compatibility'}
 assert row['status'] in {'implemented','partially-verified','verified','unresolved','not-applicable'}
 for name in ('changes','affected_paths','tests','remaining','compatibility'):assert isinstance(row[name],list)
 for p in row['affected_paths']:assert Path(p).is_file(),p
 for test in row['tests']:
  assert set(test)=={'command','result','evidence'}
  for p in test['evidence']:assert Path(p).is_file(),p
doc=Path('docs/development/PERM.md')
for link in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',doc.read_text()):
 assert (doc.parent/link.split('#')[0]).is_file(),link

proof=json.loads(Path('docs/development/evidence/PERM-host-fixture-integrity.json').read_text())
fixture=Path(proof['shared_fixture_path']).read_text()
assert hashlib.sha256(fixture.encode()).hexdigest()==proof['shared_fixture_sha256']
reconstructed=fixture.replace('/** Shared, unchanged Compose-runtime scenarios; Android runs them with a real Robolectric runner. */\ninternal class RememberPermissionCallbacksFixture {','/** Real Compose-runtime recompositions, not a hand-copied rememberUpdatedState imitation. */\nclass RememberPermissionCallbacksTest {')
for name in ['rememberedSingleUsesLatestCallbackWithoutReplacingState','rememberedEmptyBatchStillCallsLatestCallbackExactlyOnce','unsupportedBatchReportsAllDistinctMembersWithOneCallback']:
 reconstructed=reconstructed.replace('    fun '+name+'() = runTest {','    @Test fun '+name+'() = runTest {')
assert hashlib.sha256(reconstructed.encode()).hexdigest()==proof['original_sha256']

assert all(row['status']=='partially-verified' for row in records)
for name in ['PERM-core-desktop-android-second.json','PERM-desktop-second.json','PERM-android-host-first.json']:
 receipt=json.loads((Path('docs/development/evidence')/name).read_text())
 for p,sha in receipt['evidence_sha256'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha,p
 for report in receipt['reports']:assert hashlib.sha256(Path(report['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==report['sha256'],report['path']
counts={}
hashes={}
for p in sorted(Path('calf-permissions').rglob('*.kt')):
 if '/src/' not in str(p):continue
 hashes[str(p)]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 if 'Test/' in str(p):
  module=p.parts[1];target=p.parts[3]
  key=module+'/'+target
  counts[key]=counts.get(key,0)+len(re.findall(r'@Test\b',p.read_text()))
assert sum(counts.values())==92,counts
assert counts['core/commonTest']==21 and counts['core/nonAndroidTest']==3 and counts['core/androidHostTest']==20
print(json.dumps({'xml_snippets':len(blocks),'resolution_records':len(records),'test_function_inventory':counts,'test_functions_total':92,'unique_test_scenarios':89,'validation':'passed; docs/source/archived-evidence validation only, not additional library execution','source_sha256':hashes},indent=2))
result: Passed: 28 XML snippets, 18 partially-verified records, 92 declarations/89 unique scenarios, unchanged shared assertions and 27 archived test XML hashes. No new Gradle execution.
